cssDefaults: Border-box sizing, column flex containers, align-content flex-start, pre-wrap text, and overlay scrollbars with no reserved gutter.

deviation.reason: Visible-overflow items use their specified Width or Height as the automatic minimum. CSS uses min(specified size, content size). Empty CSS items can shrink to 0.
